text: Nepal today, in numbers. Twenty nine million people. More women than men, because over two million Nepalis, four fifths of them men, were abroad on census day. Life expectancy seventy one. Two children per woman. And maternal deaths down from five hundred and thirty nine to one hundred and fifty one per hundred thousand births, one of the fastest falls ever recorded.
